priorState: Certified export loaded clean on staging+production but the improved-parcel null count for 48453 did not move (397065->396743, 100% null both times); root cause: pacs/parser.ts readImprovementRollups matches typeDesc.startsWith('MAIN AREA'), never present in TCAD's real IMP_DET.TXT (TCAD types living-area segments typeCd 1ST/2ND/3RD).

design.mechanism: A per-county living-area segment vocabulary declared in lib/cad-ingest/src/sources.ts (same registry P-169 used). TCAD declares ['1ST','2ND','3RD']. A segment counts as living area if its typeCd is in the county's declared list OR (universal fallback) typeDesc starts with 'MAIN AREA'. Undeclared counties (Bastrop, Caldwell) get only the MAIN AREA default -- byte-identical to today, verified by an unmodified passing fixture built from real Caldwell rows.
design.refusal: If a file matches zero segments for its county, readImprovementRollups now throws ImprovementVocabularyMismatchError naming the county, expected vocabulary, and up to 15 distinct (typeCd,typeDesc) combos actually seen -- never a silent all-null rollup.

falsifierPreRegistered: If after the re-load through the fixed parser the improved-parcel null count on cad_property does NOT fall for 48453, the vocabulary is still wrong and the row is not done.
